parts.name: Cover
parts.Basic_description: This is the cover of a trash can, made of polypropylene plastic. It is circular and fits snugly on top of the container.
parts.Functional_description: The cover prevents odors from escaping and keeps the contents of the trash can enclosed. It can be lifted or rotated to open.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or rotated around the hinge or rim area to open or close the trash can.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main container body of the trash can, made of polypropylene plastic. It is cylindrical and designed to hold waste.
parts.Functional_description: The container holds the trash and supports the cover. It may have handles for carrying and is designed to be durable and easy to clean.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during normal use but can be lifted or tilted when emptying or cleaning.
